description: Intent i016 (SNAPSHOT=s04, BRANCH=proc-config-write-unterminated) complete. Primary finding in snapshots/s04: drivers/net/netdevsim/fib.c lines 1378-1385, nsim_nexthop_bucket_activity_write — the debugfs control file "nexthop_bucket_activity" (registered at fib.c:1537) accepts user writes of size up to sizeof(buf)==128; copy_from_user(buf, user_buf, size) fills the 128-byte stack array with no NUL terminator (no buf[size]='\0', buf not zero-initialized), and sscanf(buf, "%u %hu", &nhid, &bucket_index) then consumes buf as a C string — with a 128-byte all-digit payload the token scan runs past the end of buf (unbounded stack OOB read), exactly the seed's exact-length-usercopy-then-string-parser invariant with a stack array in place of the heap allocation. Secondary reported candidate: drivers/s390/cio/cio_inject.c lines 98-103, crw_inject_write — vmemdup_user(buf, lbuf) allocates exactly lbuf bytes with no +1 terminator slot and sscanf(buffer, "%x %x %x %x %x %x %x", ...) scans past the allocation for an all-hex-digit write. Also kept: ice_debugfs.c:174/260/335/431 (memdup_user count<=2..8 then sscanf(cmd_buf,"%s",user_val) on unterminated buffer), bnad_debugfs.c:315/375 (byte-for-byte seed pattern in Brocade bna, overlapping debugfs branch i014), rtw89/debug.c and fs/proc/base.c:2775 unresolved. Safe with concrete evidence: rvu_debugfs.c:1002 (count+1 plus explicit cmd_buf[count]='\0'), btrfs ioctl.c (memchr NUL check), smackfs.c (smk_parse_smack len-bounded kstrndup), acpi/proc.c:101 (count capped, strbuf[count]='\0'), aoechr.c:101 (size<16 plus buf[15]='\0'), test_udelay.c:110, ntb_tool.c:934, dlm debug_fs.c:714/853 ({} zero-init plus min()-capped copy plus bounded %NNs), toshiba_acpi.c proc writes (len cap + cmd[len]='\0' or memdup_user_nul), lparcfg.c, reconfig.c (memdup_user_nul), qib_fs.c:333 (binary consumption). Bounded negative evidence: 92 .proc_write handlers across 53 files scanned with a copy_from_user/memdup→string proximity window, plus all 212 memdup_user/vmemdup_user sites enumerated — the string-consumer hits found are enumerated above; the remainder are struct/binary consumers. Limitations: no KASAN reproducer was run (read-only tree, artifacts under $TMPDIR); 10-12 line proximity windows could miss string uses farther away or via helpers; configfs/securityfs/tracefs store surfaces only partially enumerated; sscanf %u stops at non-digits so the OOB read requires an all-digit (resp. all-hex) payload filling the full buffer without an in-bounds NUL. Final artifact at agent-state/findings/i016.json with snapshots_checked=["s04"].
